hero_prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production 2D game idle animation sprite sheet. Input image is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND ART STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate a NEW sheet of exactly 16 FULL BODY sprites in a precise equal 4 columns by 4 rows grid. Same character identity, face, outfit, proportions and detailed painted anime game style as reference. Canvas square, actual alpha transparent background, no text, no lines, no labels, no floor/shadow, no glow, no attack effects. All characters face three-quarter RIGHT. Every cell has generous fully transparent gutter, every complete weapon and hair inside cell. All sprites same scale with boots at identical baseline per row and body ground midpoint at cell center. Body occupies about 65 percent cell height. These are calm STANDING IDLE poses, NEVER running/attacking/jumping. Four columns form a subtle loop: neutral relaxed guard, gentle inhale/upper chest rise and tiny grip lift, neutral with hair settling, gentle exhale and tiny grip relaxation; last blends back to first. Keep BOTH boot positions fixed, only shoulders/head/hands/hair/cloth animate. Rows represent DISTINCT held weapon stances: ROW 1 short crimson sword relaxed low guard in one hand; ROW 2 heavy black-gold greatsword held with two hands braced diagonally LOW, weight bearing shoulders; ROW 3 ornate blue crystal staff upright beside body with gentle wrist lift, calm spellcaster stance; ROW 4 compact black/gold longbow held low, quiet ranged guard with free hand relaxed. The four frames in each row use EXACTLY THE SAME WEAPON DESIGN. Do not copy attack poses. Character: Feiyue: long silver-white hair, red eyes, black gothic short dress with white sleeves and red ribbons, gold trim, black ankle boots
